$comment: For future evolution, new top-level properties must be added to the main 'properties' block due to 'unevaluatedProperties: false'. Consider splitting modules into separate schema files for improved maintainability and validator performance with very large schemas. See also: https://json-schema.org/understanding-json-schema/structuring.html
title: UILensAI Comprehensive Analysis Report
description: Schema for the UILensAI analysis report, version 3.11.0, generalized for all industries, with refined enterprise feedback, enhanced visualization, deeper module metrics, standardized real-time data, and robust pagination support. This version uses JSON Schema Draft 2020-12.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the report was generated.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this report schema (e.g., 4.0.0). Major version 4 adds site health and competitor benchmarking.

deprecatedFields.description: List of fields that are deprecated and will be removed in future versions.

fieldPath.description: JSON path to the deprecated field (e.g., '/modules/performance/oldMetric'). Uses JSON Pointer notation.

replacementPath.description: JSON path to the new field, if any (e.g., '/modules/performance/newMetric'). Uses JSON Pointer notation.

removalVersion.description: Schema version in which this field is planned for removal (e.g., '4.0.0').

schemaValidationErrors.description: List of schema validation errors encountered during report generation. Empty array if no errors.

instancePath.description: JSON pointer to the location of the error in the data.

schemaPath.description: JSON pointer to the location of the failing schema.

keyword.description: The schema keyword that failed validation.

params.description: Additional parameters related to the validation error.

tier.description: Service tier under which the report was generated. All scans default to 'Pro' (full-featured).

overallStatus.description: Comprehensive completion status for the entire report generation process.

featureSet.description: Lists features enabled for this report, typically based on tier and analysis depth.

realTimeDataIntegrationEnabled.description: General flag if any module supports real-time data for this tier.

debateVerdicts.description: Challenger/Defender debate results for adversarial scoring.

ceoVerdict.description: Final executive review of the adversarial scoring adjustments.

streamingSupport.description: Indicates if the report generation process supports streaming for very large outputs. If true, 'pagination' object at the root might be null for the current chunk, and consumers should expect potentially more chunks. Module-level paginated arrays will still use their pagination controls for their respective data within the current chunk/report. Application should clarify behavior to user based on context.

streamChunkType.description: Indicates the type of chunk if streamingSupport is true. 'complete' means this is the full report or streaming is not active. 'intermediate' means more chunks will follow. 'final' means this is the last chunk. Null if streamingSupport is false or status is unknown.

totalItems.description: Total items across all pages for the entire report query.

pagination.description: Pagination details if the top-level report content itself is part of a larger dataset (e.g., if multiple URLs were analyzed in a batch and this is one page of that batch report). If streamingSupport is true and streamChunkType is 'intermediate', this field should be null. If streamingSupport is true and pagination is present (and streamChunkType is 'final' or 'complete'), it refers to the pagination of the overall dataset. Application logic should clarify behavior to user based on context.

localization.description: Localization settings and supported languages for the report content. Null for Basic tier, basic for Pro, full for Enterprise.

reportLanguage.description: Primary language of this report instance (BCP 47 tag, e.g., 'en-US', 'fr-CA', 'zh-Hant'). Default 'en-US' if localization is not enabled for the tier.

supportedLanguages.description: List of languages the analysis engine can target or report in.

regionSpecificBenchmarks.description: Benchmarks specific to a region, supplementing global/industry benchmarks.

modules.description: List of modules requested for this analysis.

device.description: Primary device type targeted for analysis.

industryHint.description: User-provided hint for the website's industry.

pipelineSource.description: Records data sources used for this analysis run.

screenshotProvider.description: Screenshots via Cloudflare Browser Rendering or local Playwright.

performanceProvider.description: Performance data from Google PSI API or local Lighthouse CLI.

htmlProvider.description: HTML for signal extraction from HTTP fetch+cheerio or Playwright.

crawlProvider.description: Multi-page crawl data from Cloudflare or disabled.

viewports.description: Viewports used for screenshot capture and analysis.

modules.description: Contains the detailed analysis results for each module specified in `testParameters.modules`. Implementations MUST ensure that if a module (e.g., 'ui') is listed in `testParameters.modules`, then a corresponding key ('ui') and its data object exist in this `modules` object, and that object validates against its schema definition.

overallScore.description: Overall weighted score for the website based on enabled modules.

totalEstimatedRevenueUplift.description: Sum of estimated revenue uplifts from all modules.

totalEstimatedConversionIncrease.description: Weighted average or sum of conversion increases.

combinedConfidenceLevel.description: Overall confidence in the aggregated ROI.

primaryContributingModules.description: Modules contributing most significantly to the overall ROI.

moduleContributions.description: Breakdown of ROI contribution by module.

estimatedRoiValue.description: Estimated monetary value or percentage uplift from this module.

contributionPercentage.description: Percentage contribution to the total ROI.

notes.description: General notes about the overall ROI projection.

overallRoiProjections.description: Aggregated Return on Investment projections from all applicable modules. Potentially null for Basic/Pro tiers.

notes.description: Any specific notes about this module's execution.

inconclusiveReason.description: When status is Inconclusive, explains why the module could not produce trustworthy results. The module ran but its output is unreliable (e.g., PSI scored an error page as perfect).

retryCount.description: Number of retries for this module.

moduleStatus.description: Summary status for each module run.

totalAvailableItems.description: Total number of recommendations available before tier-based maxItems truncation.

topRecommendations.description: A curated list of the top N most impactful recommendations from all modules. MaxItems for the 'items' array varies by tier.

insight.description: The synthesized insight spanning multiple modules.

crossModuleRecommendations.description: Coordinated recommendations arising from this insight.

metricPairs.description: Examples of metric pairs considered for this insight.

dependencies.description: Mapping of dependencies between recommendations across modules.

sourceRecommendationId.description: ID of the source recommendation (references recommendation.id).

dependentRecommendationId.description: ID of the dependent recommendation (references recommendation.id).

insightPrioritization.description: Automated prioritization details for this insight, if applicable.

priorityScore.description: Overall priority score for this insight.

strategicInsights.description: Insights derived from the interplay between different analysis modules. Potentially null for Basic tier.

visualizationData.description: Data structured for frontend visualization components. Potentially null or limited for Basic tier.

chartId.description: Unique ID for this chart configuration.

options.description: Chart.js compatible options structure or custom options.

metricSource.description: Path to the primary metric this chart represents (e.g., 'performance.metrics.largestContentfulPaint.value').

drillDownTarget.description: Identifier or path for where single-level drill-down should lead.

targetChartId.description: ID of the chart to drill down to for this level (must reference an existing chartId in visualizationData).

filterContext.description: Context to pass for filtering the target chart.

filterOptions.description: Available filter dimensions for this chart (e.g., ['module', 'industry', 'dateRange']).

exportOptions.description: Options for exporting this visualization. Potentially null for Basic tier.

commonRatingLabels.description: Standardized descriptive rating labels based on a 0-100 score.

commonRatingLabelsNoNull.description: Standardized descriptive rating labels (excluding null) based on a 0-100 score.

topIssues.description: A brief list of the most critical issues found by this module.

strengths.description: A brief list of strengths and positive findings for this module.

retargetingEvidence.description: Evidence collected from pixel detection, specific to marketing.

location.description: Specific location of the issue (e.g., URL, page section).

evidence.description: Verifiable evidence of the finding (e.g. DOM node, HTTP header snippet).

selector.description: CSS selector for the problematic element, if applicable.

regulatoryReference.description: Reference to a specific regulation or guideline (e.g., WCAG SC, GDPR Article).

description.description: Alias for text or extended details.

details.description: Additional structured details about the issue.

id.description: Unique ID for this recommendation. Implementations should ensure uniqueness (e.g., prefix with moduleName or reportId).

source.description: The module or system that generated this recommendation.

impact.description: Qualitative description of the positive impact if implemented.

isVerified.description: True if the recommendation applies to an element or metric that was deterministically observed on the page. False if the AI hallucinated the target element.

selectorSource.description: Provenance of the elementIdentifiers used in this recommendation.

elementIdentifiers.description: Specific elements on the page this recommendation applies to.

effortBreakdown.description: Breakdown of effort by task and role.

regulations.description: Specific regulations impacted (e.g., GDPR, WCAG 2.1 AA, HIPAA).

details.description: Further technical details or code examples.

score_impact.description: Estimated positive impact on the relevant module's score if implemented (0-100 scale).

testingGuidance.description: Suggestions on how to test the implementation of this recommendation.

successMetrics.description: Key metrics to track to measure the success of this recommendation.

reasoning.description: AI's reasoning behind this recommendation or its priority.

mitigationSteps.description: Steps taken or recommended to mitigate this bias.

primaryIndustry.description: Detected primary industry of the website. Free-text description (e.g., 'Hair Salon', 'Dermatology Practice', 'E-commerce Fashion').

subtype.description: Specific subtype (e.g., Hospital, Fintech, E-commerce Fashion).

confidence.description: Confidence score (0-100) for the detected industry.

otherDescription.description: Details if 'Other' is selected for name. Expected if name is 'Other'.

regulatoryFramework.description: Applicable general regulatory frameworks. Industry-specific ones are in industryStandards.

industryStandards.description: Specific standards, benchmarks, or regulations relevant to the detected industry. Examples: 'HL7 FHIR' (Healthcare), 'FINRA Rules' (Finance), 'ISO 9001' (Manufacturing), 'Section 508' (Government), 'IATF 16949' (Transportation & Logistics), 'NIST Cybersecurity Framework' (Technology), 'OWASP ASVS' (Web Application Security).

relevanceScore.description: Relevance of this standard to the specific website/subtype.

targetAudience.description: Inferred target audience profile (e.g., 'Patients and Caregivers' for Healthcare, 'Retail Shoppers' for Retail, 'Students and Educators' for Education, 'B2B Buyers' for Manufacturing, 'Logistics Managers' for Transportation & Logistics, 'General Public' for Government).

keyConversionGoals.description: Likely key conversion goals for this type of website.

sourceIndustry.description: Specific industry this average pertains to, if different from primary.

additionalProperties.description: Average value for a specific metric in this industry.

industryAverages.description: Object containing average values for key metrics in the detected industry.

benchmarkCustomization.description: User-defined or dynamically loaded benchmarks for comparison.

benchmarkDataSource.description: Sources for the benchmark data used.

provider.description: e.g., Statista, Gartner, UILensAI Internal Data

url.description: URL to the data source, if public.

competitivePosition.description: How the site's performance on key metrics compares to industry averages.

improvementOpportunity.description: Estimated potential for improvement relative to industry benchmarks (e.g., percentage points).

industryBenchmarks.description: Comparison against industry benchmarks for relevant metrics.

revenueUplift.description: Estimated percentage or absolute revenue uplift.

conversionIncrease.description: Estimated percentage point increase in conversion rates.

bounceRateReduction.description: Estimated percentage point reduction in bounce rate.

timeToRealize.description: Estimated time to realize these benefits (e.g., '3-6 months').

methodology.description: Brief methodology used for ROI calculation (e.g., 'Based on industry averages', 'AI-driven projection', 'Monte Carlo Simulation').

methodologyDetails.description: More detailed explanation of the methodology, assumptions, and data sources used for confidence level and projections.

assumptions.description: Key assumptions made for these projections.

roiProjection.description: Return on Investment projections for implementing recommendations. Potentially null for Basic tier.

qualitativeImpact.description: Description of the overall business impact (positive or negative if issues are not addressed).

metric.description: Business metric affected (e.g., Sales, Leads, User Engagement, Brand Reputation).

strategicAlignment.description: How improvements align with broader business strategies.

businessImpact.description: Assessment of the business impact of the findings and recommendations.

potentialFines.description: Estimated potential fines due to non-compliance (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

breachCost.description: Estimated cost of a data breach.

mitigationCost.description: Estimated cost to mitigate identified risks.

industry.description: Specific industry for this risk profile.

averageBreachCost.description: Average cost of a data breach in this industry.

source.description: e.g., IBM Cost of a Data Breach Report, Verizon DBIR.

financialRisk.description: Assessment of financial risks related to security or privacy issues. Potentially null for Basic tier.

implementationPlan.description: Structured plan for implementing accessibility improvements.

overallComplianceScore.description: Aggregated score reflecting overall adherence to selected regulations.

name.description: Name of the standard/regulation. Common standards are documented (e.g., WCAG 2.2 AA, GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, Australia Privacy Act, India DPDP Act, FERPA, SOX, COPPA), others are free-form strings with isCustomStandard set to true.

isCustomStandard.description: True if the 'name' is not from a predefined list of common standards and should be treated as a custom entry.

standardVersion.description: Version of the standard, if applicable (e.g., '2.1 AA' for WCAG).

industryRelevance.description: Industry this standard is particularly relevant to (e.g., Finance, Healthcare, Education).

score.description: Compliance score for this specific standard.

gaps.description: Identified compliance gaps for this standard.

moduleReferences.description: Modules contributing to this standard's assessment.

recommendations.description: Specific recommendations to address gaps for this standard.

crossJurisdictionalAnalysis.description: Analysis of compliance across different legal jurisdictions, if applicable.

regulatoryComplianceOverview.description: Overview of the website's adherence to relevant regulations and standards. Potentially null for Basic tier.

realTimeDataFeed.description: Configuration and status of real-time data integration for a module. Application should handle static fallbacks if null or for tiers without real-time access. For Basic tier, keyMetrics may be limited.

source.description: e.g., 'Live RUM data', 'Performance Monitoring Service', 'Internal SIEM', 'Threat Intelligence Platform', 'Google Analytics Real-Time API', 'Custom Event Stream'

refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often the data feed is expected to update, in seconds.

dataRetentionPolicyDays.description: How long the source data is typically retained, in days.

averageResponseTimeMs.description: Average time for element to respond to interaction.

maxResponseTimeMs.description: Maximum time for element to respond.

modalResponseTimeMs.description: Specific for modals: time to appear/disappear.

typographyScore.description: Overall score for typography (readability, hierarchy, consistency).

uiConsistencyScore.description: Score for UI consistency across viewports and elements.

dynamicElementsAnalysis.description: Analysis of dynamic UI elements like modals, carousels, accordions.

gestureInteractionAnalysis.description: Analysis of gesture-based interactions, primarily for mobile.

industrySpecificPatterns.description: Analysis of UI patterns specific to the detected industry (e.g., 'Fintech Dashboard Widgets' for Finance, 'E-commerce Product Carousel' for Retail, 'Healthcare Patient Portal Navigation' for Healthcare, 'Interactive Course Catalog' for Education, 'Citizen Service Portal Forms' for Government, 'Donation Flow Elements' for Non-profit).

narrative.description: Expert narrative analysis providing deep qualitative insights, evidence-based reasoning, and contextual recommendations beyond what structured fields capture.

viewportAnalyses.description: Analysis results for each captured viewport.

recommendations.description: Cross-viewport specific brief recommendations or notes.

edgeCases.description: Analysis of UI behavior on extreme or non-standard viewports.

analysis.description: Textual analysis of the edge case.

score.description: Overall score for this edge case handling.

priority.description: Priority for addressing edge case issues.

screenshot.description: Path to the screenshot for this edge case.

analysis.description: Overall textual analysis for this viewport.

accessibility.description: Viewport-specific accessibility notes, not a full audit.

recommendations.description: Viewport specific brief recommendations or notes.

issues.description: Specific issues identified for this viewport.

screenshot.description: Path to the screenshot for this viewport analysis.

rating.description: Rating for this category (0-100 scale, will be mapped to 10-word labels by application).

text.description: AI-generated textual analysis for this category.

description.description: Description of why this element is evidence.

visualEvidence.description: References to specific elements in the screenshot as evidence.

oneOf.description: Chrome User Experience Report (CrUX) real-world field data from PSI API. Null if site has insufficient Chrome user traffic.

overallCategory.description: Overall CrUX assessment of page load experience.

metrics.description: Individual CrUX metric percentiles and categories.

percentile.description: 75th percentile value for this metric across real users.

category.description: CrUX category based on the percentile value.

fieldData.description: CrUX real-world field metrics. Only available for sites with sufficient Chrome user traffic.

source.description: Data source: Google PageSpeed Insights API or local Lighthouse CLI.

savings.description: e.g., 'Potential savings of X ms' or 'Y KB'.

multiBrowserComparison.description: Performance metrics comparison across different browsers.

narrative.description: Expert narrative analysis providing deep qualitative insights, evidence-based reasoning, and contextual recommendations beyond what structured fields capture.

value.description: The metric value (e.g., in milliseconds or a unitless score).

unit.description: Unit of measurement if applicable (e.g., ms, s, KB).

industrySpecificMetrics.description: Performance metrics specific to the detected industry.

aeoAnalysis.description: Answer Engine Optimization analysis for featured snippets, PAA, and direct answer engines.

agentReadinessReport.description: Raw agent readiness report from isitagentready.com MCP endpoint.

headingHierarchy.description: True if H1-H6 hierarchy is logical.

contentGapAnalysis.description: Topics covered by competitors but not by the site.

freshness.description: e.g., Last updated date, or staleness assessment.

coverageScore.description: How well content answers conversational queries.

intentAlignmentScore.description: Score for how well content aligns with inferred user intent for conversational queries.

urlStructure.description: Assessment of URL structure (e.g., SEO-friendly, too long).

sitemapXml.description: True if sitemap.xml is found and valid.

robotsTxt.description: True if robots.txt is found and valid.

openGraphTags.description: Presence and correctness of OG tags.

twitterCardTags.description: Presence and correctness of Twitter Card tags.

platformOptimization.description: Optimization for specific social platforms and overall synergy. Keys are platform names (e.g., 'linkedin', 'twitter', 'instagram', 'facebook'). Example value for 'linkedin': {'engagementScore': 85, 'followerGrowthRate': 5.2}

engagementScore.description: Overall engagement score for the platform.

contentReach.description: Average reach per post or campaign.

shareabilityCorrelationScore.description: Correlation between website content shareability and social engagement.

source.description: e.g., Yelp, G2, Healthgrades, Avvo, RateMyProfessors, ThomasNet

isValid.description: Whether local business structured data is valid.

narrative.description: Expert narrative analysis providing deep qualitative insights, evidence-based reasoning, and contextual recommendations beyond what structured fields capture.

phiHandling.description: Assessment of handling practices for Protected Health Information (PHI) or similarly sensitive data. Includes checks for encryption at rest (e.g., AES-256 with appropriate key management), encryption in transit (e.g., TLS 1.2+ with strong ciphers), role-based access controls (RBAC), audit trails for PHI access, data de-identification/anonymization techniques where applicable, and data minimization strategies. Null if not applicable (e.g., non-Healthcare industry or no PHI/sensitive data detected).

accessControlsScore.description: Score for effectiveness of access controls to sensitive data.

sensitiveDataIdentified.description: Whether PHI or other highly sensitive data is identified as being handled by the site.

hipaaAuditLogging.description: Evaluation of audit logging capabilities relevant for HIPAA compliance, or similar stringent regulatory requirements for other industries (e.g., financial transaction logging for SOX). Covers log enablement (e.g., access logs, modification logs, system event logs), retention policies (e.g., minimum 6 years for HIPAA), integrity and review processes, and access protection mechanisms for audit trails (e.g., immutability, restricted access, regular reviews). Null if not applicable.

logReviewProcessScore.description: Score for the effectiveness of log review processes.

narrative.description: Expert narrative analysis providing deep qualitative insights, evidence-based reasoning, and contextual recommendations beyond what structured fields capture.

directives.description: Key-value pairs of directives for CSP, Permissions-Policy. Values can be strings or arrays of strings for multiple sources.

clearLanguage.description: Consent language is clear and unambiguous.

withdrawalOption.description: Is there an easy way to withdraw consent?

dataProcessingAgreement.description: Indicates if a DPA is likely in place or needed.

dataSharingPractices.description: Assessment of data sharing with third parties.

dsarMechanism.description: Is there a clear Data Subject Access Request mechanism?

dataTransfers.description: Are data transfers outside the primary jurisdiction likely?

visualizationHint.description: Suggested visualization type, e.g., 'Sankey Diagram', 'Data Flow Diagram'.

suggestedChartId.description: Optional ID to link this data flow map to a chart in visualizationData.

viewportCoverage.description: Percentage of common viewports adequately covered.

relativeUnitsPercentage.description: Estimated percentage of relative units (%, vw, vh, em, rem) vs absolute (px, pt).

imageResponsiveness.description: Score based on use of <picture>, srcset, sizes.

deviceIdentifier.description: e.g., specific iPhone model, Android device

industryDevicePreferences.description: Common device preferences for the detected industry.

browserMetrics.description: Key-value pairs of browser name and its compatibility score/issues.

ariaAttributeSupport.description: Score for consistent ARIA attribute support across browsers.

coreFunctionalityScore.description: How well core functionality works with JS/CSS disabled.

featureFlagUsageScore.description: Assessment of feature flag usage for progressive rollouts.

legacyBrowserSupport.description: Metrics specific to legacy browser support e.g., IE11

polyfillLoadSizeImpact.description: KB impact if polyfills are loaded for legacy.

industryTouchpointPatterns.description: Common touchpoint patterns for the detected industry.

available.description: If heatmap data was available or inferred.

keyFindingsSummary.description: Summary of insights from session replays.

timeSpent.description: Average time spent on this step in seconds.

location.description: Page or element where drop-off occurs.

urgency.description: Score for use of urgency tactics.

conversionRate.description: Conversion rate of users who clicked the CTA.

userImpact.description: How this failure impacts users with disabilities.

focusManagementScore.description: Effectiveness of features supporting focus (e.g., clear task flows, minimal interruptions).

distractionAvoidanceScore.description: How well the design avoids unnecessary distractions (e.g., auto-playing media, excessive animations).

customizableInterfaceScore.description: Availability of options to customize the interface (e.g., font size, contrast, layout).

textComplexityScore.description: Based on readability scores and use of plain language.

sensoryOverloadScore.description: Assessment of potential sensory overload triggers (e.g., excessive motion, flashing content, sound).

predictableLearningCurveScore.description: Score for ease of learning and predictability for neurodiverse users.

clarityRequirement.description: e.g., Simple Language for Education, Precise Terminology for Finance

paginationControls.description: Reusable pagination controls for arrays within modules.

path.description: Relative or absolute path to the screenshot file.

signedUrl.description: Public URL to access the screenshot (when stored in blob storage).

blobPath.description: Path to the screenshot in blob storage.

urlAccess.description: Access control metadata for the screenshot URL

clientId.description: Client/API key ID authorized to access

score.description: Quality/relevance score of the screenshot itself.

coverage.description: Percentage of the page captured, if not full page.

issueMappings.description: Issues directly mapped to annotations or areas in this screenshot.

siteHealthModule.description: Site-wide health analysis from multi-page crawling.

orphanPages.description: URLs with zero inlinks from other crawled pages
